nodes.text: We are talking about metapneumovirus. Symptoms: chills, cough, sore throat, weakness and dizziness. It is especially common among children. There is unconfirmed information that a state of emergency has been declared in some regions, but there is no official confirmation.

nodes.author: 2_vatalive
nodes.text: The first infected people are already in the UK.
